messages.label: THE WORK RANT
messages.body: This meeting could've been a nap.
messages.consequence: Your manager volunteers you to run the next meeting.
messages.avoided: Your meeting review stays between friends.

messages.label: THE SURPRISE
messages.body: Don't tell Sam about the party.
messages.consequence: Sam asks what time to start acting surprised.
messages.avoided: Sam still has no idea. The surprise survives.
